response.overview: Drawn to the promise of a paradise, Ligaya enters a world that offers pleasure, escape, and the freedom to forget. What begins as an innocent curiosity slowly becomes a cycle of dependence, where leaving proves far more difficult than entering. In a place where every awakening feels like a beginning, Ligaya must confront the cost of a paradise that may never have been paradise at all.
response.tagline: Paradise is synonymous with a state of total bliss ay pure joy... right?
response.title: Muntin Paraiso
